App.//: Where the emailed verification and reset links point. Override with APP_BASE_URL.

Google.//: OAuth 2.0 Web client id from Google Cloud Console. Override with GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID. Empty disables the Google button.

Smtp.//: Leave Host empty to log emails to the console instead of sending them. Override with SMTP_HOST, SMTP_PORT, SMTP_USERNAME, SMTP_PASSWORD, SMTP_FROM.
